transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?
I'm here because I need help dealing with the people who are monitoring me. I've noticed they are tracking my movements and watching my apartment, and I just don't know who else to turn to.
Have you been experiencing any periods where your mood is unusually high, energetic, or irritable, or conversely, periods where you feel deeply sad, hopeless, or lack all motivation?
No, I haven't really experienced those kinds of extreme emotional highs or lows. My mood is generally fine, apart from the stress of being watched all the time.

Aside from the belief that you are being watched, have you noticed any other unusual experiences, such as hearing voices that others cannot hear or feeling like your thoughts are being broadcast to people around you?
No, I don't hear any voices, and my thoughts are definitely my own. I'm just dealing with the fact that these people are physically tracking me and watching my every move.
How long have you felt that these people have been tracking your movements and watching your apartment?
It has been going on for about a year and five months now. It started out subtle, but over this past year and a half, it's become very clear that they are constantly keeping tabs on me.
Has this situation with the people you believe are watching you caused you to have significant problems with your job, your social life, or your ability to take care of your daily responsibilities?

Honestly, my daily life and job are generally fine, and I can still take care of all my normal responsibilities. It is definitely stressful and distracting to know I'm being watched, but I still manage to go to work and get things done every day. Aside from that constant worry, my routine hasn't really changed.
